text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back to the academy with
Silence
Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It feels like she's been looking over my
way a lot...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. Can you stop by the
trainer's office?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Um... I meant, like... just you, by
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'll... catch up with you afterwards.
If you
don't
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to the trainer's office and wait
for
her, just
as she asked.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just a second. Don't turn around yet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay, you can look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I turn around to find...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A snow globe identical to the one
Silence Suzuka
got from the arcade the
other day sits on my
desk.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I managed to get this one all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's the same snowy landscape that I love
so much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And when you hit this switch, it lights up
and the
snow swirls around. It's really
pretty...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It looks just like the place where I grew
up.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So... Um...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What do you think?
choice_data_list: The snow back in your hometown mus...
The snow back in your hometown mus...
Can I try flipping the switch?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm so relieved...
choice_data_list: The snow back in your hometown mus...
The snow back in your hometown mus...
Can I try flipping the switch?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's like... an actual weight has been
lifted off my
shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You know...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I could break into a run right this
instant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a long look at the matching snow
globe
Silence Suzuka brought me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to display the small piece of
winter
scenery in a prominent position in
my room.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's right.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's so peaceful with the snow piled up

everywhere. It feels like you've been
sucked into
a new world.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Running there feels amazing... like you
could go
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
And just keep running forever... You
begin to wish
the scenery would never
end.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Definitely. I'm sure the scenery would
look even
more beautiful with you by my
side.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see it someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka describes her hometown
while
gazing down at the miniature
winter landscape.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The snow globe lights up as powdered
flakes
dance around the two snowmen
inside.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Isn't it pretty?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of the little snowmen tips over
suddenly and
ends up leaning against
the other.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It fell over.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, why don't we trade snow globes?
choice_data_list: Even though Suzuka went out of her...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I like this one. The little
snowman isn't
lonely with his friend so
close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, Silence Suzuka and I trade
snow
globes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems very content as she returns
home with
the globe, the snowmen
nestled close together.
